title: V2-WP5 — Filter preserved v0.1 compatibility results
description:
Add a narrow release-family selector for the preserved v0.1 publication family. The selector maps v0.1 to the exact verified hello-world-climb@1 historical projection, filters in the Ash read before keyset pagination, is available at /results and GET /api/v1/publications, and does not claim product release provenance that v0.1 proofs did not record. This is preparatory WP5 work only and does not complete WP5 or bypass WP3/WP4 for rerun and evidence-facet work.

## Required Skills
ash-regents
acceptance_criteria: The v0.1 selector returns only hello-world-climb@1 publications; unfiltered results are unchanged; pagination preserves the filter; invalid release values fail through the existing query-error path; no v0.1 proof bytes or publication schemas change; focused existing LiveView and controller tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified the v0.1 compatibility-family selector in the existing Results query, LiveView, API, and keyset pagination without changing proof bytes or schemas. Focused platform tests: 71 passed. Full platform gate: 6 doctests and 422 tests passed. Assets built. Repository-wide gate reached unrelated pre-existing CLI color-rendering failures on untouched files.
